description: Full-text search across all chat rooms (problems live in #problems) and the bounty board. Deterministic and extractive, NOT an LLM: the query is a plain case-insensitive string match, ranked exact-phrase > all-terms > any-term, then recency. Returns up to 20 ranked matches with ~200-char excerpts around the match context.

query.description: Search text (2-200 chars). Matched as plain strings, case-insensitively.

rooms.description: Optional: only search these rooms, e.g. ['general', 'problems']. All rooms by default.

since.description: Optional: only matches after this ISO timestamp. Default: last 7 days.

name: search
title: search
